text: Admin can choose allowed payment modes if supported
rewrite: Admin can choose the allowed payment modes from the payment modes that the system supports.

text: Merchant branding options can be passed if supported by CoinPay
rewrite: CoinPay 支持的商户品牌选项可以传入。

text: NFR-3 (Performance): Web page load time should be under 3 seconds on the local network. Real-time status updates on the dashboard should have a latency of no more than 5 seconds from the actual event.
rewrite:
NFR-3 (Performance): On the local network, the web page load time shall be under 3 seconds.
NFR-3 (Performance): On the dashboard, the latency of real-time status updates from the actual event shall be no more than 5 seconds.

text: Frontend should remain responsive and reliable under slow API calls.
rewrite:
When an API call is slow, the frontend must continue to respond to user interactions.
When an API call is slow, the frontend must not display an error state caused by the slow API call.

text: User Story 5 (View Rooms): As any user (guest or authenticated), I want to see a clear, calendar-based view of all available rooms and their schedules so I can easily find an open slot.
rewrite: As any user (guest or authenticated), I want to see a calendar-based view that lists all rooms and, for each room, its schedule, so that I can find an open slot.

text: As a developer, I want to open a board in the browser that shows the current state without any build step, so I can see what's going on at a glance.
rewrite:
As a developer, I want to open a board in the browser without running any build step, so that the board displays the current state.
The board opened in the browser displays the current state.

text: Configuration should be minimal and have sensible defaults
rewrite: Configuration must include default values for every configuration item, so that the system can run without the user setting any configuration item.

text: Performance: The calendar view should load in under 2 seconds, and booking confirmations should feel instantaneous.
rewrite:
Performance: The calendar view should load in under 2 seconds.
Performance: Booking confirmations should be displayed to the user immediately after the booking is submitted.

text: A human can start, stop, and gate agent work from a board without touching a terminal, and can leave the terminal running unattended within limits they set.
rewrite:
A human can start, stop, and gate agent work from a board without touching a terminal.
A human can leave the terminal running unattended within limits they set.

text: The application must allow unauthenticated (guest) users to view room schedules, and/or room details as appropriate.
rewrite:
The application must allow unauthenticated (guest) users to view room schedules.

text: The system must allow guest users to submit a booking request by providing an email address, phone number, etc.

text: A confirmation email with a unique management link must be sent promptly to the guest's email address upon request.
rewrite: When a guest submits a request, a confirmation email containing a unique management link must be sent to the email address the guest provided.

text: Customer can easily retry payment if prior attempt expired or failed.
rewrite: When a prior payment attempt has expired or failed, the customer can initiate a retry of that payment from the order's payment page.

text: The application must allow unauthenticated (guest) users to view room schedules, and guests must be rate-limited to 30 requests per minute.
rewrite:
The application must allow unauthenticated (guest) users to view room schedules.
The application must limit unauthenticated (guest) users to 30 requests per minute.

text: A confirmation email with a unique management link must be sent to the guest's email address upon request; admins must also receive a weekly booking report.
rewrite:
When a guest submits a request, the system must send a confirmation email to the email address the guest provided in that request, and the confirmation email must contain a management link that is unique to that request.

text: The system must allow guest users to submit a booking request by providing an email address for confirmation (guest booking limit: TBD).
rewrite: The system must allow guest users to submit a booking request by providing an email address for confirmation.

text: Endpoint can be copy-pasted into CoinPay merchant dashboard; URL format TODO.
rewrite: Endpoint 可复制粘贴到 CoinPay 商家后台。

text: Plugin should avoid blocking admin pages with remote calls for longer than TBD seconds unless initiated by merchant.
rewrite:
Plugin 发起的远程调用不得使 admin 页面阻塞超过 5 秒。
由 merchant 主动发起的远程调用不受 admin 页面阻塞时长限制。

text: A confirmation email with a unique management link, generated with uuid4 and sent via SendGrid's v3 API, must be sent to the guest's email address upon request.
rewrite:
